line_text: Schedule: View. The user can see the schedule page, navigate between day/week/month views, use the mini calendar, search, filter, view all technicians' shifts and events, hover for tooltips, and open shift/event detail modals in read-only mode. This is the experience for roles like Technician, Parts Manager, Parts Tech, Office, and Time Clock. When Schedule: View is OFF, the Schedule top-level nav item is hidden entirely.

line_text: The schedule always shows all technicians' shifts and events for every user who has Schedule: View. There is no role-based restriction to "own shifts only." This is intentional: the schedule is a shared coordination resource that service advisors and managers use to orchestrate work across the team. The "My Shifts" toggle in the Filter and Display dropdown (§9) provides this as an optional personal convenience filter, not a security boundary.
